subject: Next steps: Private/VPC architecture review — availability and attendees
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Rodriguez <carlos.rodriguez@medienergy.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-01T14:05:00-04:00
Subject: Follow-up + scheduling: Private/VPC architecture review

Carlos — thanks again for the discovery call this morning. High-level recap: Medienergy is evaluating a private/VPC deployment to keep telemetry and inference data in your cloud account, with strict egress controls and KMS-managed keys. You mentioned three priorities: (1) predictable latency for inference traffic, (2) clear audit/logging for compliance, and (3) a path for a partially air-gapped on-prem option in future phases.

Next step we recommended on the call: a focused architecture review with our solutions engineering team to map network flows, discuss VPC peering vs. PrivateLink alternatives, and confirm controls (KMS/HSM options, audit logs, retention). Proposed windows (all in ET):
- Tue Aug 4 — 09:00–10:00 or 11:30–12:30
- Wed Aug 5 — 09:00–10:00

Could you confirm what works for your team and who will join from Medienergy (cloud infra, security, procurement)? If helpful, we can reserve a 60-minute slot and split into a 40-min joint review + 20-min security breakout.

I've attached a short preliminary architecture note and an infra inventory template that helps us prepare (CIDRs, firewall egress, current VPC diagrams). Also: link to a quick calendar RSVP if you prefer to pick a slot: https://calendar.redwood.ai/s/arch-review-availability

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0127

Attachments: redwood-prelim-arch-note.pdf, medienergy-infra-inventory.xlsx

From: Carlos Rodriguez <carlos.rodriguez@medienergy.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kumar <neha.kumar@medienergy.com>, ops@medienergy.com
Date: 2026-08-02T10:12:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + scheduling: Private/VPC architecture review

Thanks Lauren — appreciate the clear recap. Aug 4 or Aug 5 would work. Our preference is a 60-minute block so we can run through network topology and then have a short Q&A with our security lead. My initial availability (ET):
- Tue Aug 4: 09:00–11:00 (best)
- Wed Aug 5: 08:30–10:00

Attendees from Medienergy: Neha Kumar (Head of Cloud Ops), Miguel Torres (Network Engineer), and I will join. We can also loop in procurement if you want to touch on contract/terms briefly, but probably not necessary on the first call.

A couple of pre-req questions:
1) Do you need VPN or temporary access to our network diagrams (we can share a PDF ahead of time)?
2) Will Redwood bring someone who can speak to KMS/HSM integrations and audit log retention?

On the call we want to validate whether VPC peering + NAT gateway will meet our constraints or whether PrivateLink or transit VPC is a better fit for cross-region data flows. Also interested in possible on-prem gateway patterns for later phases.

Thanks — Carlos
Carlos Rodriguez
Director, Cloud Services | Medienergy
carlos.rodriguez@medienergy.com | +1 617-555-0199

> On 2026-08-01, Lauren Bishop wrote:
> > Carlos — thanks again for the discovery call this morning. High-level recap: Medienergy is evaluating a private/VPC deployment...

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Rodriguez <carlos.rodriguez@medienergy.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-02T16:45:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + scheduling: Private/VPC architecture review

Great — thanks for the note and attendee list, Carlos. We can absolutely cover KMS/HSM integration and audit/retention during the session. I've added Sergio Alvarez (Solutions Architect) to the thread so he can lead the technical portion. Aditya (cc'd) will be on the call to cover deployment options and follow up on procurement questions if they come up.

Let's confirm Tue Aug 4, 09:00–10:00 ET (60 minutes). I'll send a calendar invite after you confirm. Agenda we'll follow:
1) 15–20m: Current infra & constraints (Medienergy presents network diagram + CIDRs)
2) 25–30m: Redwood solutions and recommended topology (VPC peering vs PrivateLink, egress controls, KV cache placement, quantization/latency tradeoffs)
3) 10–15m: Security & compliance Qs (KMS/HSM, audit logs, retention) + next steps (PO, NDA, POC plan)

Pre-reqs to make the time productive: if you can share a simple VPC diagram (PNG/PDF), current CIDR blocks, and a list of expected ingress IP ranges for inference traffic. The infra inventory template I attached captures this. If you prefer to share via a secure link, send the Drive/Box link and we will confirm access.

I've attached the preliminary architecture note and the inventory template again for convenience. Also here's the quick calendar link to accept: https://calendar.redwood.ai/s/arch-review-availability

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0127

Attachments: redwood-prelim-arch-note.pdf, medienergy-infra-inventory.xlsx

From: Carlos Rodriguez <carlos.rodriguez@medienergy.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kumar <neha.kumar@medienergy.com>, Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@medienergy.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T09:23:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + scheduling: Private/VPC architecture review

Confirmed — Tue Aug 4 at 09:00 ET works for us. Neha will circulate the network diagram and the list of CIDRs before EOD tomorrow. We would like the security breakout to include an attendee who can speak to audit log retention and encryption-at-rest policies; looks like Sergio is the right person.

Also, we may want to schedule a follow-up specifically on procurement terms once we validate the topology. I'll ask procurement to be on standby. See you Tuesday.

— Carlos

> On 2026-08-02, Lauren Bishop wrote:
> > Great — thanks for the note and attendee list, Carlos. We can absolutely cover KMS/HSM integration...
